name.en: Infrared-Radio Image of the Large Magellanic Cloud Caption: The Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC) is a satellite of the Milky Way, containing about 30 billion stars. Credits: Image - ESA, NASA, NASA-JPL, Caltech, Christopher Clark (STScI), S. Kim (Sejong University), T. Wong (UIUC)
